AI Assistant Pricing Compared (2026): Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini for Business

Explainerlowob research

By Chris WellsFrom lowob RESEARCH · 16 November 2026 · 7-minute read · Strategy

For business, Microsoft 365 Copilot Business lists at $21 per user per month on annual billing, ChatGPT Business and Claude Team at $20, and Google includes Gemini in Workspace Business Standard at $14, as checked on vendors' pages on 16 November 2026. Google's price covers the whole suite; the others sit on top of one. The seat is also no longer the whole bill.

Choosing an assistant is mostly about fit, connectors, controls and logging, which our guide Which AI assistant, which seats covers. lowob's pricing hub, Seats, usage or outcomes, explains why seat plans are turning into hybrids. This page is the price list, checked on each vendor's own page on 16 November 2026, in US dollars.

How much do AI assistants cost for business in 2026?

Standard business seats cost $20 to $21 per user per month on annual billing at Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic, and premium seats $100. Google bundles Gemini into Workspace suite prices from $7.

For larger firms, Microsoft's October 2025 announcement of its Copilot Credit pre-purchase plan listed the Microsoft 365 Copilot user licence at $30 per user per month. That figure is a year old, so confirm it on a current quote.

Which AI assistant is cheapest for a business?

On list price, Gemini, if the firm already runs Google Workspace Business Standard, because there is no separate AI charge. Among add-on assistants, ChatGPT Business and Claude Team standard seats at $20 annual are $1 a month below Copilot Business at $21, or $2 above it during Microsoft's first-year promotion.

The comparison is not like for like. Copilot and Gemini sit inside the suite where email, files and meetings already live. ChatGPT and Claude are bought on top of a suite. The cheapest seat that nobody uses is the most expensive line in the budget; seat-based pricing for AI covers how to size seats to a workflow.

Is Copilot included in Microsoft 365?

Copilot Chat is; the full Microsoft 365 Copilot is not. Microsoft's pricing page, checked 16 November 2026, says "Copilot Chat is a web-grounded AI assistant included at no additional cost with eligible Microsoft 365 plans". Microsoft 365 Copilot Business is an add-on at $21 per user per month annually, available only to existing customers with an eligible Business plan, or bought in a bundle such as Business Standard with Copilot at $23.50.

Is Gemini included in Google Workspace?

Yes, in Business and Enterprise plans, since January 2025. Google's announcement on 15 January 2025 said customers no longer needed an add-on, and gave the example of a Business Standard customer who had paid $32 per user per month with the Gemini Business add-on now paying $14. On the Starter plan, Google's comparison table, checked 16 November 2026, lists Gemini in Workspace apps as "Limited", with no Gemini in Docs, Sheets or Slides.

What costs sit outside the seat price?

Usage beyond the seat's limits, and agents.

Microsoft says usage-based features, including Copilot Cowork and Copilot Autopilot, "use Copilot Credits", and that charges apply only when they are used. OpenAI's help centre says Business workspaces can buy credits that "extend usage beyond the included rate limits". Anthropic's footnote says how fast a user reaches a limit "depends on the model you use, how long your chats are, and how large your files are", and its Enterprise plan bills usage at API rates on top of the seat.

OpenAI said on 2 April 2026 that it was cutting the ChatGPT Business annual price from $25 to $20 per seat and adding pay-as-you-go Codex seats billed on token consumption. A 24 June 2026 update said new pay-as-you-go Codex seats were no longer available on Business plans.

What does a 20-person team pay per year?

Between $3,360 and $5,040 a year for standard seats on list prices, before any metered usage. The arithmetic below uses annual billing for 20 users and the prices in the table above.

OptionAnnual cost for 20 usersWhat the price covers
Gemini in Google Workspace Business Standard$3,360The whole Workspace suite, Gemini included
ChatGPT Business, standard seats$4,800The assistant only
Claude Team, standard seats$4,800The assistant only
Claude Enterprise, 20-seat minimum$4,800 plus usage at API ratesThe assistant; usage billed separately
Microsoft 365 Copilot Business add-on$5,040; $4,320 in the promotional first yearCopilot only, on top of Microsoft 365 licences
ChatGPT Business, 5 premium and 15 standard seats$9,600The assistant, with more usage for 5 heavy users

Monthly billing raises each seat line by 20% to 25%. Buy annual seats only for people with a defined task, and keep pilots monthly until weekly use is known.

lowob takeaways

  • Standard seats cluster at $20 to $21. Premium seats cost five times as much at OpenAI and Anthropic.
  • Suite assistants are priced differently. Gemini is inside the Workspace price; Copilot is an add-on to Microsoft 365.
  • The seat is not the whole bill. Credits, limits and API-rate usage sit beside it at every vendor.
  • Promotions end. Microsoft's $18 price applies to the first year only.

Common questions

How much does Microsoft Copilot cost for business?

Microsoft's pricing page, checked on 16 November 2026, lists Microsoft 365 Copilot Business at $21 per user per month on annual billing and $25.20 monthly. A promotional $18 applies to the first year for purchases between 1 July and 31 December 2026. It is an add-on for existing Microsoft 365 Business customers, and some usage-based features consume Copilot Credits.

How much does ChatGPT Business cost per user?

OpenAI's help centre, checked on 16 November 2026, lists ChatGPT Business standard seats at $20 per user per month billed annually or $25 monthly, and premium seats at $100 annually or $125 monthly. A workspace needs at least two seats. Workspaces can buy credits to extend usage beyond the included rate limits.

How much does Claude Team cost?

Anthropic's pricing page, checked on 16 November 2026, lists Claude Team standard seats at $20 per seat per month on annual billing or $25 monthly, and premium seats at $100 or $125 with five times the usage of standard seats. Teams can have 2 to 150 seats, and usage limits apply. Claude Enterprise charges $20 per seat plus usage at API rates.

Is Gemini free with Google Workspace?

Gemini is included in Google Workspace Business and Enterprise plans at no extra charge, a change Google announced on 15 January 2025. Google's help centre, updated 10 November 2026, lists Business Standard at $14 per user per month on an annual plan. The Starter plan, at $7, includes the Gemini app but only limited Gemini features inside Workspace apps.

Which is cheaper, Copilot or ChatGPT for business?

On list prices checked in November 2026, ChatGPT Business standard seats cost $20 per user per month annually, against $21 for Microsoft 365 Copilot Business. During Microsoft's first-year promotion, Copilot is $18. Copilot also requires a Microsoft 365 Business licence, while ChatGPT does not, so compare total cost for the people who will actually use it.
